about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice C): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Malaysian Chicken Curry Mee Soup
recipes.summary: A coconut chicken noodle soup with a mild curry paste, tofu puffs and bean sprouts.
steps: Blend the shallots, garlic and ginger with the curry powder into a paste.
Fry the paste in the oil for 6 minutes until the oil separates and it smells toasty.
Add the chicken and stir until it is sealed on all sides.
Pour in the stock and simmer for 15 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Stir in the coconut milk and tofu puffs and heat for 5 minutes until hot.
Boil the noodles until tender, divide among bowls, then ladle over the soup and top with sprouts and lime.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C and no pink remains.
Add sambal on the side for extra heat.

recipes.title: Sambal Tumis Prawns
recipes.summary: Prawns cooked in a sweet, sticky tamarind chilli sambal, served over steamed rice.
steps: Cook the rice according to the packet until fluffy, then keep warm.
Fry the onions in the oil for 6 minutes until soft and golden.
Add the garlic and chilli paste and fry for 4 minutes until the oil rises to the top.
Stir in the tamarind, sugar and tomatoes and simmer for 5 minutes until jammy.
Add the prawns and cook for 3 minutes until pink and opaque.
Serve spooned over the rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the prawns until opaque and pink all the way through.
Balance the sweet, sour and heat with extra sugar or tamarind.

recipes.title: Telur Dadar Malaysian Omelette
recipes.summary: A thin, crisp-edged omelette with onion, chilli and spring onion, folded over and served with rice or toast.
steps: Whisk the eggs with the fish sauce and white pepper until well combined.
Stir in the onion, chilli and spring onion.
Heat the oil in a frying pan until shimmering.
Pour in the egg and cook for 3 minutes until the base is golden and crisp at the edge.
Flip and cook for 1 minute until the egg is fully set, then fold and serve.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until firm with no liquid egg remaining.
Serve with sambal and plain rice.

recipes.title: Corn Chowder with Smoked Paprika
recipes.summary: A creamy summer corn chowder with potato, smoked paprika and bacon.
steps: Fry the bacon in the butter for 6 minutes until crisp, then lift out.
Soften the onion in the same pot for 5 minutes until translucent.
Add the paprika, potato, corn and stock and simmer for 15 minutes until the potato is tender.
Blend a third of the soup until smooth and stir back in.
Add the milk and heat gently, then top with bacon and spring onion.
notes: Food safety: cook the bacon until crisp and fully cooked.
Do not boil after adding milk.

recipes.title: Spring Pea and Mint Soup
recipes.summary: A vivid green spring soup of peas, mint and lettuce, served with a swirl of cream.
steps: Soften the onion in the butter for 5 minutes until translucent.
Add the stock and bring to a simmer until the surface bubbles lightly.
Add the peas and lettuce and cook for 5 minutes until just tender but still green.
Add the mint and blend until completely smooth.
Season and serve with a swirl of cream.
notes: Do not overcook or the green turns dull.
Serve hot or chilled.

recipes.title: Wombok and Ginger Chicken Broth
recipes.summary: A clear chicken broth with wombok, ginger and egg noodles, light and restoring.
steps: Simmer the stock with ginger and garlic for 10 minutes.
Add the chicken and poach for 6 minutes until cooked through at 75°C.
Add the noodles and cook for 3 minutes until tender.
Stir in the wombok until just wilted.
Season with soy sauce and sesame oil.
notes: Food safety: poach the chicken until it reaches 75°C with no pink.
Add chilli oil at the table.

recipes.title: Ribollita Tuscan Bread Soup
recipes.summary: A thick Tuscan soup of cannellini beans, cavolo nero and day-old bread, better the next day.
steps: Fry the onion, carrot, celery and garlic in half the oil for 10 minutes until soft.
Add the tomatoes, stock and half the beans and simmer for 20 minutes.
Mash the remaining beans and stir in.
Add the cavolo nero and cook for 10 minutes until tender.
Tear the bread into the soup and stir until it thickens.
Serve with remaining oil.
notes: Vegan.
Reheat the next day until thick.
Food safety: Reheat leftovers until steaming hot right through.

recipes.title: Cold Soba Salad with Sesame Dressing
recipes.summary: Chilled soba, cucumber and edamame in a soy and sesame dressing, a light summer meal.
steps: Boil the soba for 5 minutes until tender, then rinse under cold water.
Cook the edamame for 3 minutes until bright green.
Whisk the soy sauce, tahini, vinegar and honey until smooth.
Toss the noodles, vegetables and dressing until coated.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds.
notes: Check the soba is 100% buckwheat for gluten-free.
Serve cold.

recipes.title: Waldorf Salad with Walnuts
recipes.summary: Crisp apple, celery and grapes in a light yoghurt dressing with toasted walnuts.
steps: Toast the walnuts in a dry pan until golden and fragrant.
Slice the apples and celery and toss with lemon juice.
Mix the yoghurt and mayonnaise.
Fold the apples, celery, grapes and walnuts through the dressing until coated.
Spoon into lettuce cups and serve straight away.
notes: Contains egg in the mayonnaise.
Squeeze lemon on the apple to stop browning.

recipes.title: Chicken Larb Lettuce Cups
recipes.summary: Minced chicken tossed with lime, fish sauce, mint and toasted rice powder in crisp lettuce cups.
steps: Cook the chicken mince in the oil for 8 minutes, breaking it up, until it reaches 75°C and no pink remains.
Cool the cooked chicken for 2 minutes until just warm.
Toss with lime juice, fish sauce, rice powder and chilli.
Fold through the shallots and herbs.
Spoon into the lettuce leaves.
notes: Food safety: cook mince until it reaches 75°C and no pink remains.
High-protein and dairy-free.

recipes.title: Quinoa and Roasted Pumpkin Salad
recipes.summary: Fluffy quinoa with roasted pumpkin, chickpeas, rocket and a lemon tahini dressing, vegan and high in protein.
steps: Roast the pumpkin and chickpeas with the oil at 200C for 25 minutes until golden.
Cook the quinoa for 15 minutes until the grains uncurl.
Whisk the tahini, lemon juice, garlic and water until smooth.
Toss everything until coated.
Serve warm or cold, as a side or a main.
notes: Dairy-free and vegan.
Keeps 3 days.

recipes.title: Prawn and Avocado Salad
recipes.summary: Chilled prawns with avocado, cucumber and a lime and chilli dressing.
steps: Whisk the lime juice, oil and chilli.
Slice the avocado and cucumber.
Arrange the lettuce on a platter.
Layer with the avocado, cucumber and prawns.
Spoon over the dressing until coated.
notes: Food safety: use fully cooked prawns kept cold, with flesh opaque and pink.
Eat within a day.

recipes.title: Garlic Butter Mushrooms on Toast
recipes.summary: Golden mushrooms in garlic butter and thyme piled on crisp sourdough.
steps: Heat half the butter in a pan until foaming.
Add the mushrooms and cook for 6 minutes until deeply golden.
Add the garlic, thyme and remaining butter for 1 minute until fragrant.
Toast the bread until crisp.
Pile the mushrooms on top.
notes: Vegetarian.
Don't crowd the pan.

recipes.title: Shakshuka with Chickpeas
recipes.summary: Eggs poached in spiced tomato and capsicum sauce with chickpeas.
steps: Soften the onion and capsicum in the oil for 8 minutes until soft.
Add garlic and spices for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the tomatoes and chickpeas and simmer for 10 minutes until thick.
Make wells and crack in the eggs.
Cover and cook for 6 minutes until the whites are set.
Top with chopped parsley and serve straight from the pan.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are fully set.
Serve with bread.

recipes.title: Green Smoothie Bowl with Seeds
recipes.summary: A thick spinach, avocado and pineapple smoothie topped with seeds.
steps: Blend the spinach, avocado, pineapple and coconut milk until thick and smooth.
Pour into a bowl and smooth the surface flat.
Top with the seeds and coconut.
notes: Vegan.
Use frozen pineapple for thickness.

recipes.title: Potato Rosti with Poached Egg
recipes.summary: A crisp grated potato cake topped with a soft poached egg and chives.
steps: Grate the potato and onion and squeeze out the water.
Season and shape into two cakes.
Fry in the butter for 8 minutes per side until deep golden.
Poach the eggs in simmering water with the vinegar for 3 minutes.
Top the rosti with the eggs.
notes: Food safety: poached eggs have a runny yolk, so cook until firm for vulnerable people.
Squeeze potato well for crispness.

recipes.title: Overnight Chia-Style Sesame Muesli
recipes.summary: Soaked oats with sesame, apple and coconut milk, vegan and dairy-free.
steps: Mix the oats, coconut milk, water, apple, cinnamon and syrup.
Cover and refrigerate overnight until the oats are soft.
Stir in sesame seeds and serve cold.
notes: Vegan.
Add fruit before serving.

recipes.title: Tzatziki Dip
recipes.summary: Thick yoghurt with grated cucumber, garlic, dill and lemon.
steps: Grate the cucumber and squeeze out the water until dry.
Mix with the yoghurt, garlic, dill and lemon juice until combined.
Chill for 30 minutes and drizzle with oil.
notes: Vegetarian.
Squeeze the cucumber well.

recipes.title: Tahini Lemon Sauce
recipes.summary: A creamy lemon tahini sauce with garlic for falafel and roasted vegetables.
steps: Whisk the tahini, lemon juice and garlic.
Add the water slowly until the sauce turns pale and smooth.
Season to taste with salt and more lemon until bright.
notes: Vegan and dairy-free.
It seizes before it loosens, so keep whisking.

recipes.title: Pesto Genovese Dairy-Free
recipes.summary: A fresh basil and pine nut pesto without cheese, using nutritional yeast.
steps: Toast the pine nuts until golden.
Blend with the basil, garlic and yeast until a coarse paste forms.
Stream in the oil and lemon juice.
Season with salt and serve straight away at room temperature.
notes: Vegan and dairy-free.
Cover with oil to stop browning.
